title: OpenAleph and FtM tax entity mapping
scope: Map companies, persons, ownership, invoices, payments and evidence using supported FtM schema plus documented tax extensions

acceptance.text: Map companies, persons, ownership, invoices, payments and evidence using supported FtM schema plus documented tax extensions
Validate entities and provenance; test conflicting ownership and repeated ingest
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Validate entities and provenance; test conflicting ownership and repeated ingest

evidence.text: integration/followthemoney/tax_mapping.py maps parties (Company/Person/LegalEntity), ownership (Ownership), contracts (Contract + ContractAward), invoices (UnknownLink with invoice role), payments (Payment) and TAX-032 evidence (Document) using only schemata and properties of the locked FtM source (c8c457a; schema/types identical to v4.11.2 in the OpenAleph image). Tax fields FtM cannot hold go in a documented vati_tax_extension.v1 record per entity (ADR-012). ftm_schema_subset.v1.json is generated from the locked YAML by scripts/ftm_schema_subset.py; --check passes.

tests/integration/test_ftm_tax_mapping.py, 25 tests passing: entities validated against the locked subset (schema, property, type, required, reference range); provenance rejected for hash mismatch with the stored original, unknown evidence, missing locator and missing source; conflicting ownership flagged (over 100 percent, disagreeing records) with both records kept, and successive or beneficial stakes not flagged; repeated ingest against a fake of the locked OpenAleph _bulk route sends nothing the second time, sends only new records, refuses a changed entity with idempotency_conflict, keeps the ledger on a failed batch and maps 403 to forbidden; all five TAX-024 scenarios map and validate. Not run: the real followthemoney library (PyICU does not build here, and Smart App Control blocks SQLAlchemy's compiled module even with DISABLE_SQLALCHEMY_CEXT_RUNTIME=1) and a live OpenAleph (Docker not running).

scripts/validate.py passes. Every dev.py check step was run with the venv interpreter (python3 is a Store stub on this machine): data, integration (119), ai refund/imported, contracts, backend and compileall pass; tests/tooling has 2 Windows-only failures (POSIX 0600 file-mode checks in the jube_dev/openaleph_dev env tests, untouched here). ruff check and format pass on all quality.py sources; mypy is left to CI because Smart App Control blocks it locally. Review PR opened for Keletso as integration area owner.
